title: Chocolate Cookie Milkshake
fullMethod: Keep 180 ml milk and 260 g vanilla ice cream cold until blending. The blender jar and lid must be clean and dry; do not combine the ingredients yet.
Break 60 g chocolate biscuits into small irregular pieces using clean hands. Reserve roughly one spoonful of crumbs to scatter over the finished two glasses.

Put 260 g vanilla ice cream, 180 ml cold milk and 12 g unsweetened cocoa powder into the blender. Close the lid and blend low for 10 seconds then medium for 20–30 seconds until smooth. No biscuit pieces or syrup at this stage.
With blender stopped, add most of the broken chocolate biscuits and pulse only two or three times so small real biscuit pieces remain visible in the chocolate milkshake. Keep reserved crumbs aside.

Divide 20 ml chocolate syrup between two cold tall glasses, run thin irregular streaks along the glass interiors, pour in the cookie milkshake and scatter reserved chocolate biscuit crumbs over both. Serve immediately. No whipped cream.
fullMethodKo: 차가운 우유 180ml와 바닐라 아이스크림 260g을 갈기 직전까지 차갑게 보관하고 깨끗하고 물기 없는 믹서 용기와 뚜껑을 준비한다.
초콜릿 쿠키 60g을 불규칙하고 작은 조각으로 부순 뒤, 마지막에 올릴 약 한 숟가락 분량을 별도로 둔다.
믹서에 바닐라 아이스크림 260g, 차가운 우유 180ml, 무가당 코코아가루 12g을 넣고 뚜껑을 닫아 저속 10초, 중속 20~30초 부드럽게 간다. 아직 쿠키와 시럽을 넣지 않는다.
믹서를 멈춘 상태에서 잘게 부순 쿠키 대부분을 넣고 2~3번만 짧게 작동해 부스러기 식감을 남긴다. 장식용 부스러기는 따로 유지한다.
차가운 키가 같은 유리잔 두 개 안쪽에 초콜릿 시럽 총 20ml를 나눠 가늘게 바르고 셰이크를 나눠 담는다. 남은 쿠키 부스러기를 올려 즉시 마신다. 휘핑크림은 넣지 않는다.

stages.scene: PHOTO HERO, TWO matching real clear 350 ml glasses of chocolate cookie milkshake, side by side, same height and fill level, touching ivory quartz with genuine contact shadows. Warm light chocolate shake with sparse fine dark cookie flecks, fine drizzles of dark chocolate syrup clinging to INSIDE glass walls, restrained teaspoon of authentic crushed dark chocolate biscuit crumbs on the surface of EACH glass (not a mound). Exactly TWO slim brown paper drinking straws total, ONE correctly inserted per glass, angled slightly, no third straw. No cream, ice cubes, whole cookies, marshmallows, hands, text, other toppings. Natural premium but imperfect cafe food photo.

STEP ONE PREP. A CLEAN EMPTY DRY glass blender pitcher on stable counter, with black lid removed beside it. A separate short plain glass measuring cup filled with COLD white milk and a separate small ceramic bowl filled with 2 to 3 real scoops of plain VANILLA ICE CREAM. All three objects visibly stand on stable pale ivory quartz. Milk and ice cream absolutely NOT in the blender yet. No blender lid on jar, no graduated numbers, no text, no floating or merged glassware, no chocolate or cookie ingredients yet. Close composition of actual uncombined food.

STEP TWO BISCUITS: Authentic CRUNCHY DARK CHOCOLATE BISCUITS that are flat, baked, round, dry crisp cookies. Several roughly broken jagged biscuit pieces are closely grouped on a small WOODEN cutting board. Small separate pinch of fine biscuit crumbs in a tiny ceramic bowl beside the main pile, both fully supported on board/ivory quartz. Cookie texture should be CRISP, thin, brittle and baked, NOT fudgy soft brownies, truffles, cake sponge, chocolate fudge, chopped candy, or cookie dough balls. Small genuine crumbs and irregular broken edges, photorealistic candid close-up.

STEP THREE BLEND. One real 1.5 litre transparent upright blender jar firmly seated on its matching black motor BASE resting on quartz. BLENDER LID PROPERLY CLOSED. Its integrated transparent handle fully joined to pitcher at BOTH ends, no severed dangling glass. Only 1/3 to 1/2 of the jug is filled with smooth light cocoa-milkshake liquid from vanilla ice cream, milk and cocoa (enough for two normal glasses). NO biscuits yet, NO dark specks, NO syrup, no extra toppings or food, no spoon in the closed blender. Realistic unbranded household blender, grounded and natural shadows.

STEP FOUR ADD COOKIES. Show SAME NORMAL BLENDER: clear upright blender jar LOCKED onto real black motor base on quartz, genuine attached handle, 1/3 to 1/2 full of light cocoa-coloured thick milkshake. Blender OFF, black lid resting flat next to it, visibly open jar top showing SMALL CRISPY BROKEN DARK CHOCOLATE BISCUIT PIECES resting in milkshake before brief pulse. A few cookie specks inside the drink, no spills outside the blender. No unrelated jars, smoothie serving cups, cookie crumbs on counter, hovering utensils or hands. Slight overhead close photo revealing open pitcher mouth, realistic kitchen scale.

STEP FIVE SERVE: TWO identical straight-sided 350 ml tall glasses physically resting on pale ivory speckled quartz, filled evenly with light chocolate cookie milkshake and tiny natural crunchy dark biscuit flecks. Chocolate syrup 10ml per glass produces a few thin dark irregular streaks on INSIDE glass walls. Exactly a very LIGHT scattering of reserved dry dark chocolate biscuit crumbs on the surface of each glass, no hill of crushed biscuit; drink surface fully visible. Natural slightly uneven homemade appearance, no cream or ice, NO STRAWS in this step, no whole cookies on rims, no extra garnishes, no spoon, no fake drips floating in air.
